seed_ledger.name: American Electric Power Company Inc: gas supply to its plants in development (group 3 of 3)
seed_ledger.reason: KPCO 2023 IRP power station (Kentucky Power, Big Sandy site): DC tie yes. In October 2026 Kentucky Power told the state commission it will drop the 450 MW turbine at Big Sandy and seek a 760 MW combined-cycle plant in Lawrence County for 2031 to serve TeraWulf's Muskie Data Campus, with TeraWulf paying the financing. Gas supply: AEP asked for bids in August 2025 for a new pipeline lateral to the Big Sandy plant at Louisa, but no source names a winning sponsor or project, so no candidate (the existing Big Sandy Pipeline P8098 serves the site today and is not tied to the new plant by any source seen). Hallsville Natural Gas Plant (Southwestern Electric Power Co): 450 MW at the former Pirkey coal site, a new lateral is needed (AEP bid request for a lateral from September 2024, bids due November 2024, 126,600 Dth per day, start December 2027), but no source names the pipeline sponsor or project. Data center tie is weak: only a local news story says data center demand drove the conversion, with no filing or contract naming it for this plant. Treated as NOT_FOUND for the supply line and a weak DC tie, left as monitor. Searches run: 6. Sources checked: WEKU on the October 2026 Kentucky Power filing (plant for the TeraWulf campus); AEP bid notice for the Big Sandy lateral (lateral wanted, no winner named); SWEPCO draft bid request for the Hallsville lateral (lateral, no sponsor); News-Journal December 2024 and Shreveport Advocate July 2026 on Hallsville (data center demand mentioned generally, no pipeline named).

evidence.note: Kentucky Power seeks 760 MW gas plant for 2031 to serve TeraWulf Muskie Data Campus
Kentucky Power bid request for gas lateral and firm capacity to the Big Sandy plant at Louisa
SWEPCO draft bid request for gas lateral to Hallsville plant, no sponsor named
data center demand mentioned generally for Pirkey/Hallsville plant

seed_ledger.name: Venture Global Holdings Inc: gas supply to its plants in development
seed_ledger.reason: CP2 LNG Terminal power station: NO_DC_TIE, onsite power islands for the liquefaction plant; gas arrives by CP Express (existing roster row P3589, 91.4 mi, under construction), which has no data center tie in any source seen. Plaquemines LNG Terminal power station: NO_DC_TIE, onsite plant for the terminal, served by the Gator Express lines already on the roster (P0193, P3193, P5415). Venture Global's separate plan for up to 10 GW of gas power for AI data centers is company-wide, names no site or customer, and is not about these two plants, so it is not a tie. Searches run: 2. Sources checked: Venture Global FY2025 annual report (CP2 power islands for terminal, 10 GW AI plan is separate and unsited); Venture Global CP Express page (48-inch, about 85 miles, feeds CP2 terminal).
